result:
Everything passes. Summary of work done:

**Built `ClauseAnalysisPage` (UC4) and its 14 owned components** in `src/features/clause-analysis/`, wired to a new `lifecycleClauseAnalysisService.js` covering all 9 contracted `/api/v1/lifecycle` endpoints, a `clauseAnalysisSlice` zustand store, and one hook per contract hook name. The page handles all four required states (unsupported-file blocker, AI-extraction-failure banner, access-denied, populated) plus the concurrent-edit conflict modal, and gates editing by role per BR-9/10/11/12 (Legal Reviewer: full edit; Contract Owner: accept/ask only; Tenant Admin: read-only; others: denied).

- Added route `/contracts/:contractId/clause-analysis` in `App.jsx`.
- Added `src/__tests__/ClauseAnalysisPage.test.jsx` (5 tests, all passing).
- `npm run lint`, `build`, and `test` all pass (30/30 tests).
- Visually verified at 1440×900 against a local fixture server, both as `TENANT_ADMIN` and `LEGAL_REVIEWER` — layout, copy, colors and controls closely match IMG-1/IMG-2.
- Result written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-CLAUSE-ANALYSIS-PAGE-UI.json` with `status: SUCCESS` and 6 blockers documenting judgment calls (no create-clause endpoint for "continue manually", no UC5 route to navigate to on success, AuditLogViewer placement inferred, etc.).
